title: Shoe Repair Patches – Fix Worn Heels & Mesh
descriptionHtml:
Give your favorite shoes a longer life

Worn heels and holes in the mesh make nice shoes feel worn out before their time. Buying new ones for a bit of wear is both expensive and unnecessary.

Easy repair that lasts

These patches are easily stuck inside the shoe and cover wear on the heel and mesh. They make the shoes comfortable again and hide the damage neatly.

Features

  • Repairs worn heels and holes in mesh
  • Self-adhesive – easy to attach
  • Makes the shoes comfortable again
  • Extends the life of your shoes
  • Fits sneakers and most shoes

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
